question: Where can I obtain the official property records needed to answer this question?

route_selection.route: Land Register / Landdirect / appropriate official ownership search
folio plus relevant filed instrument/title plan
historical Land Registry records and/or Registry of Deeds research as applicable

guardrails: Do not treat a general map search as proof of ownership.
Do not treat a current folio as a complete historical title record.
Do not assume an unregistered property is absent from the Registry of Deeds.
Do not assume a folio contains every underlying instrument needed to interpret an interest.
Do not republish personal/property data merely because it is publicly accessible; apply the project's privacy rules.
Every retrieved record must retain its source, retrieval date and legal purpose.
